last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: Hits harder the lower your HP.

guard_stance.name: Guard Stance
guard_stance.desc: Take the blows meant for your allies for a few turns.

crusader_strike.name: Crusader Strike
crusader_strike.desc: A blessed blow that may stun.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Breaks armour as well as bone.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Raises the party's defence, and you step in front.

reckless_swing.name: Reckless Swing
reckless_swing.desc: Hits harder the more hurt you are.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: A spinning strike at everything near.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.desc: The ground cracks. Some foes stagger.

quake.name: Quake
quake.desc: The earth rolls under every foe.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: A burning stone from the sky.

soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul_harvest.desc: Reaps every foe and feeds on it.

snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
snare_trap.desc: A hidden trap that may stun.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Marks a foe: its guard drops.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.desc: Hit and lift a few coins.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.desc: Quicker and sharper for a few turns.

grace.name: Grace
grace.desc: A great healing for the whole party.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.desc: The party mends gradually and ailments clear.

wild_surge.name: Wild Surge
wild_surge.desc: The wild answers. Some foes fall asleep.

rally_cry.name: Rally
rally_cry.desc: A rousing shout that heals the party.

holy_bastion.name: Holy Bastion
holy_bastion.desc: A wall of light: the party is guarded and mended.

judgement_blade.name: Judgement Blade
judgement_blade.desc: A blow of pure verdict that may stun.

war_banner.name: War Banner
war_banner.desc: Raise the banner: the party strikes harder and faster.

titan_cleave.name: Titan Cleave
titan_cleave.desc: A sweep that breaks shields and nerve alike.

fusion_bolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusion_bolt.desc: Fire and ice braided into one bolt.

elemental_ruin.name: Elemental Ruin
elemental_ruin.desc: Storm and quake on every foe.

death_coil.name: Death Coil
death_coil.desc: A coil of grave-cold that feeds the caster.

grave_wail.name: Grave Wail
grave_wail.desc: A wail from beyond. Some foes fall under a curse.

divine_aegis.name: Divine Aegis
divine_aegis.desc: A great light heals and shields the party.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.desc: Calls a fallen ally back almost whole.

verdant_rebirth.name: Verdant Rebirth
verdant_rebirth.desc: The wild mends the party over time.

mimic.name: Mirror
mimic.desc: Placeholder: a shade repeats the last spell it overheard instead (see battle.js).
